# Appendix {-}

# Analysis flowchart

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[Type of outcome variable] ~~~ B[Type of exposure variable] ~~~ C[Independent or related exposure groups] ~~~ D[Can Normality be assumed?] ~~~ E[Statistical test]

    A1[Continuous]
    B1[None]
    D1[Yes]
    E1[1-sample t-test: Module 4]
    B2[Categorical: 2 groups]
    B3[Categorical: >2 groups]
    C1[Independent]
    C2[Related]
    C3[Independent]
    D2[Yes]
    D3[No]
    B4[Continuous]

    A1 --> B1 ---> D1 --> E1
    A1 --> B2 --> C1 --> D2 --> E2
    C1 --> D3 --> E3
    B2 --> C2 --> D4 --> E4
    C2 --> D5 --> E5
    A1 --> B3 --> C3 --> D6 --> E6
    C3 --> D7 --> E7
    A1 --> B4 ----> E8

    A2[Categorical] --> B5[Categorical: ≥2 groups]
    A2 --> B6[Categorical: 2 groups]
    B5 --> C4[Independent] ---> E9[Chi-square or Fisher's exact test]
    B6 --> C5[Independent] ---> E10[McNemar's test]

```

```{r , echo=FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
knitr::include_graphics(here::here("img", "misc", "analysis-flowchart.png"))
```
